title: Literature-RAG
blurb: Ask questions of a pile of research papers
description: A retrieval-augmented generation pipeline built from scratch. It splits papers along their real structure instead of fixed token windows, searches with FAISS, and answers with Llama 3.1 through Groq.

title: Drywall Defect Segmentation
blurb: Find hairline cracks with a text prompt
description: Fine-tuned CLIPSeg to find cracks and taping joints from a text prompt, across ~6,000 images. Cracks are under 1% of pixels, so a Focal + Dice loss did most of the work (mIoU 0.52, Dice 0.67).

title: Eye Disease Classifier
blurb: From PyTorch model to TensorRT engine
description: ResNet50 vs. Vision Transformer on 5,335 eye images (84.2% accuracy), then the whole road to production: PyTorch → ONNX → TensorRT, packaged in Docker.

title: Text to Image
blurb: Type a sentence, get a picture
description: A small Streamlit app on top of Stable Diffusion XL through the Hugging Face Inference API.

title: Face Mask Detection
description: MobileNetV2 fine-tuned for edge devices, then quantized and optimized with TensorRT for live video.

title: Tree Crown Delineation
blurb: Counting trees from the sky at ISRO
description: Found tree tops in rasterized LiDAR layers and grew regions out from them to outline each crown in a dense forest.
